title: Lentil Soup
description: A large-batch lentil soup simmered with browned onions, white pepper and dry beef-flavor soup mix.

steps.instruction: Sautee onions until brown and drain well.
Add white pepper and beef flavor to boiling water and then add lentils. Bring to boil again, add sautéed onions and simmer. (cover)
Simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until lentils are tender. Note that if any resistance is met on the bottom of the pot, remove pot from burner. Remember that pilot light will cause scorching.

notes: Telma beef flavor is a dry soup mix; the recipe is meat-free as written.
Transcription note: Yield not stated in original; recorded as 1 large pot.
Timing estimated; not stated in original. Prep time is an estimate; cook time uses the upper bound of the stated 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
